title: Work Bus
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office deals with an EMF hotspot causing health concerns and a temporary relocation to a mobile work bus, which leads to discomfort and comedic mishaps. Meanwhile, Nellie seeks Andy's help with a character reference for her baby adoption, and Jim plans a family trip to the lake with a stop at a pie stand. Tensions arise over the work bus conditions and the EMF issue, culminating in a group arrival at the pie shop amid cheers.

main_threads.thread: The office faces an EMF hotspot issue causing health concerns and debate over repairs, leading to the introduction of a mobile work bus as a temporary workspace.

evidence.snippet: Toby: It's an EMF hotspot.
Oscar: It stands for electromagnetic field. Generally cause by a concentration of wiring in one area Especially if they're poorly insulated.
Dwight: I know what Jim is trying to do. He's trying to get big bad Dwight to shell out for a huge repair job while lucky Jimbo gets a paid vacation.
Dwight: In my contract, it is stipulated that I provide a temporary work space. It will arrive in one hour.
Dwight (Bus pulls into lot): Bring it in!

main_threads.thread: Nellie requests a character reference letter from Andy to support her baby adoption, which Andy initially doubts but later signs a revised version.

evidence.snippet: Nellie: I'm trying to adopt a baby.
Nellie: You wouldn't have to do anything. I would write the letter myself and you just simply sign it.
Andy: You have one minute and your minute has begun and no time will be added at the end
Andy: It's inaccurate, dishonest and…in a word? Dongwater.
Andy: Yeah. Not as is, obviously. Made a couple changes.

main_threads.thread: Jim plans a lake trip with Pam and the kids, including a stop at a pie stand, while the group experiences challenges and bonding moments on the work bus.
